def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    bg=max(set(x for r in g for x in r),key=lambda c:(H*W-max(sum(r.count(c) for r in g))) )
    # background = most common color
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    def comp(cells,color): return [tuple(cells)],None
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    rects=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            c=g[i][j]
            if c==bg or seen[i][j]: continue
            stack=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True; comps=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); comps.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and not seen[ny][nx] and g[ny][nx]==c:
                        seen[ny][nx]=True; stack.append((ny,nx))
            # check if it's a full rectangle border
            ys=[p[0] for p in comps]; xs=[p[1] for p in comps]
            y0,y1,x0,x1=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
            ok=(y1-y0+1)*(x1-x0+1)<=len(comps) and len(comps)>0
            per=sum(1 for y in range(y0,y1+1) for x in range(x0,x1+1)
                   if (y in (y0,y1)) or (x in (x0,x1)) or ((y,x) in set(comps))
            )
            if ok and per==len(comps):
                rects.append((c,y0,y1,x0,x1))
    from itertools import product
    for c,y0,y1,x0,x1 in rects:
        fill=7 if (y1-y0-1)*2+(x1-x0-1)*2 <= 9*2 or False else None
        inter_h,y_inter,x_inter=x1-x0-1,y1-y0-1
        fill=7 if inter_h<=3 and inter_x:=x1-x0-1<=3 else (2 if inter_h>3 or x_inter>3 else 7)
        if inter_h>=0 and inter_x>=0:
            fill=7 if inter_h<=3 and inter_x<=3 else 2
            for yy in range(y0+1,y1):
                for xx in range(x0+1,x1):
                    out[yy][xx]=fill
    return out

from collections import Counter
def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; rects=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            c=g[i][j]
            if c==bg or seen[i][j]: continue
            stack=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True; comps=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); comps.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and not seen[ny][nx] and g[ny][nx]==c:
                        seen[ny][nx]=True; stack.append((ny,nx))
            ys=[p[0] for p in comps]; xs=[p[1] for p in comps]
            y0,y1,x0,x1=min(ys),max(ys),min(xs),max(xs)
            border=len(comps)==(2*(y1-y0+1)+2*(x1-x0+1)-4)
            if border:
                rects.append((c,(y0,y1),(x0,x1)))
    for c,(r0,r1),(l0,l1) in rects:
        interior=[(yy,xx) for yy in range(r0+1,r1) for xx in range(l0+1,l1)]
        ia=len(interior)
        val=(7 if ia<=2 else (7 if ia%2 else 2))
        for yy,xx in interior: out[yy][xx]=val
    return out
for n in [1,2]: print(n, solve(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])
